entry.title: Listing page URLs
entry.summary: Listing page N of a hub is at /<hub>/page/N/, from 2 up; page 1 is the hub itself.
entry.content:
Page 1 is the hub page. Listing page N, from 2 up, is at /<hub>/page/N/. No page 1 URL is built, and no page past the last.

Each listing page is its own canonical URL. It sits in the site frame with the sidebar, shows the hub’s title with its page number, and has no previous or next links: the pagination takes their place.

Because these URLs are taken, a paged hub may not have a child named page. The build stops and names the hub and the child.
